note: IMP-049 change-impact contract. `npm run gate:changed -- --scope <scope>` selects the fast + affected checks a change of that scope must pass, runs a named native slice when the scope declares one, and AUTO-ESCALATES to the full normal-route gate (gate:migration) when a high-risk file is in the diff or the scope names its own escalation trigger. Checks are {godot|npm|sh}; the godot form runs res://tests/<name>.gd headless.

dungeon.contract: First-person crawl: movement/turn (arrows), the current-cell dock, chest, full map, return.

combat.contract: Combat stage, command flow, party HUD, playback — rules truth stays in CombatRound.

town.contract: Town hub + prep services: arrival ledger, recovery, market, loot, workshop, quests.

guild.contract: Adventurer creation + roster: staged class/origin/aptitude/name, front-door registration.

scenario-picker.contract: First-run world choice: card selection, legend, confirm-advances, cancel-returns.

status.contract: Global party-status glance: any-scene hotkey, read-only vitals, pauses the scene.

content.contract: Authored world data: packs, topology, chambers — no source change should be needed.

save.contract: Save/load schema + migration. Always full route — a schema slip corrupts every run.

package.contract: Packaging / exported build: title art, resource export, package smoke.

docs.contract: Docs / markdown only — no behaviour to prove.
